_README: Seed risk flags for Dhaka. Loaded by app/scoring/fixture.py, which is read by
scripts/seed_risk_flags.py (writes them to risk_flags) and by
app/scoring/surface_seeded.py (serves them with no database at all).
THIS IS SAMPLE DATA. Every source_id is prefixed `sample_` and every url uses a
`sample:` scheme, so nothing here can be mistaken for real reporting and no link
resolves. Real flags arrive in D04, extracted from live Bangla news with genuine
article URLs. If you are demoing and the flags on screen still say `sample_`, you
are showing the fixture, and the honest thing to say on stage is that this is the
seeded surface and live ingestion is the next beat.
THERE IS NO mobility_statement FIELD HERE, AND THERE MUST NEVER BE ONE.
Flag text is produced only by app/policy/framing.py::to_mobility_statement(), from
`kind`, `mobility_impact` and `place`, when this file is loaded. A fixture
containing hand-written flag prose would walk straight past the framing invariant,
and the cheap way out would be to weaken the test. Do not take it. The loader
raises if the field appears, and so does an invariant test.
Times are RELATIVE, in hours, to the moment the fixture is loaded. A fixture with
absolute timestamps is stale the next morning, and a demo whose flags are all
expired is worse than no demo. `observed_offset_hours: -2` means 'two hours ago'.
`expires_at` is absent for the same reason it is absent from every INSERT: it is
derived. The database's trg_risk_flags_expires_at owns it for stored rows, and
app/scoring/decay.py::expires_at_for() mirrors that for the seeded surface.
THE COMPACT ENTRY FORM (D02). Only these are required:
event_key  must start `seed-`, so the seeder can clear its own rows
kind       one of IncidentKind
lat, lon   coordinates
mobility_impact  one of MobilityImpact; chooses the sentence template
observed_offset_hours
Optional, and defaulted from the reviewed per-kind table in app/scoring/kinds.py:
half_life_hours, radius_m, severity_0
Optional otherwise:
place        omitted means the statement reads 'in this area'
status       defaults to 'unconfirmed'; 'confirmed' requires source_count >= 2
source_count defaults to 1
sources      omitted means the loader generates one sample reference per
source_count, from distinct publishers, chosen stably by event_key
valid_from_offset_hours / valid_to_offset_hours  forward-dated flags (D09)
That is what keeps 200 entries to one line each. The first 22 entries predate the
compact form and spell their sources out with hand-written titles; both forms work.
ORDERING. Entries are grouped by commuting corridor -- Mirpur Road, Kazi Nazrul
Islam Avenue, Rokeya Sarani, Airport Road, Progoti Sarani, the Gulistan-Jatrabari
axis -- because D06 routes around them and a corridor with one flag on it cannot
be routed around. Several are deliberately clustered so an alternative route has a
reason to exist.
Entries whose event_key starts `seed-expired-` are deliberately below the serve
threshold already, so the expiry filter is visible in a walkthrough rather than
taken on trust. Do not 'fix' them.
NOT IN THIS FILE: the chronic baseline layer. app/scoring/chronic.py derives flags
with event_key `seed-chronic-<unit>` from scripts/crime_risk_model.json, which is
real published Bangladesh Police unit statistics, and appends them to these rows.
The `chronic` entries that ARE in this file are hand-built sample data at street
level, illustrating what B11's archive mining will produce; the derived ones are
the real unit-level baseline. Both are chronic; only one is real data.
